description.text: Teaching Objectives This program aims at the cultivation of advanced, specialized and interdisciplinary talents for doing business and management in foreign economic & trade sectors and multinational companies and for doing research on teaching in teaching & research institutions. Graduates will have a good mastery of the fundamentals of economics, basic theories and practice of international trade, the development of modern international economics & trade, the social, economic, and cultural conditions of major trading partners, and the present status of modern science & technology and future trends with proficiency in English. Graduates will be familiar with the prevailing rules and practices of international trade as well as China’s foreign economic & trade policies and regulations.InternshipThey will be able to handle international business and economic cooperation.Duration of Study4 yearsDegree AwardedBachelor’s Degree in EconomicsFuture CareerThey will be qualified for careers in business, management, research, as well as publicity in economic and trade organizations.

duration.text: The International Economy and Trade at Jiangsu University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2500 USD/per year ￥ 18000 CNY/per year

materials.text: (1) Scanned page of the first page of the passport , and scanned copies of all China-related visas and residence permits for those who have experience in China;(2) Original or notarized high school graduation certificate, fresh graduates need to provide a pre-graduation certificate issued by their school ). Graduation certificate must be handed in upon registration;(3) Original or notarized transcripts of all senior high school courses;(4) Applicants who teach in English need to provide a copy of IELTS, TOEFL or Duolingo transcript with an IELTS score of 5.5 or above, a TOEFL score of 80 or above, or a Duolingo score of 100 or above;(5) Self-statement: Submit a self-statement of your intention to study in China (no less than 800 words) in Chinese or English. The content should include personal study and work experience, motivation to study in China, reasons for major selection, personal development goals after graduation, etc.(6) Foreigner physical examination form: The applicant shall strictly follow the items listed in the form for examination, the examination results are valid for 6 months;(7) Proof of financial ability (one of the following documents: proof of family savings, proof of family real estate, proof of income of parents/guardians, $5,000 and above is recommended);(8) No criminal record certificate, valid for 6 months.

requirements.text: 1) Non-Chinese citizens who are physically and mentally healthy, have good academic background, consciously abide by Chinese laws and university rules and regulations, and respect the customs and habits of the Chinese people.(2) Foreign citizens with the same academic qualifications as high school graduates and valid passports, 18-25 years old, under 18 years old need to submit a guardian guarantee. The relevant provisions of the Ministry of Education shall apply to those who were originally Chinese citizens and then acquired foreign nationality
